title: (2nd LD) Seoul shares plunge over 5 pct on AI regulation concerns after U.S. midterms
caption:
South Korean markets saw a sharp decline following the US midterm results. Investors are concerned that a shift in Congress could lead to stricter regulations for AI infrastructure.

Source: En - (2nd LD) Seoul shares plunge over 5 pct on AI regulation concerns after U.S. midterms
